chapters.label: Past three
chapters.text: A sunny day at Molineux. Mitoma picks up the ball and runs at the defence. Past one, past two, past three! He opens his body and scores!

chapters.label: Glued to his feet
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Small touches keep the ball glued to his feet.

chapters.label: Goal of the Month
chapters.text: Brighton won four to one. Later, it was named Goal of the Month!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: How does he do it? Mitoma wrote a university project on dribbling. Feet can trick you. Watch the defender's hips, not their feet, to know when to go past!
